SEARCH
Package aor.proj3t.service.interfaces

Interface TrainingService

All Known Implementing Classes:
TrainingServiceImpl
public interface TrainingService
Service interface for training management operations. This interface defines the contract for comprehensive training program management including creation, updates, approval workflows, and training area categorization.

Key training services include:

  • Training Lifecycle: Creation, updates, and deactivation of training programs
  • Training Areas: Management and categorization of training subject areas
  • Advanced Filtering: Complex training search based on multiple criteria
  • User-specific Views: Personalized training recommendations and unparticipated trainings
  • Approval Workflows: Training approval and publication processes
  • Integration Support: Notification system integration for training events

This service ensures proper training program management with authorization checks, maintains training categorization, and provides comprehensive training discovery capabilities.

  • Method Details

    • createTraining

      TrainingDTO createTraining(NewTrainingDTO newTrainingDTO)
      Creates a new training program with the provided information. Validates the training area existence and creates the training entity.
      Parameters:
      newTrainingDTO - the training data for creation including title, description, and area
      Returns:
      a TrainingDTO representing the created training program

    • updateTraining

      TrainingDTO updateTraining(TrainingDTO trainingDTO)
      Updates an existing training program with new information. Validates the training and training area existence before updating.
      Parameters:
      trainingDTO - the training data containing updated information
      Returns:
      a TrainingDTO representing the updated training program

    • deactivateTraining

      Boolean deactivateTraining(Long trainingId)
      Deactivates a training program, making it unavailable for new participation. Maintains existing participation records while preventing new enrollments.
      Parameters:
      trainingId - the unique identifier of the training to deactivate
      Returns:
      true if deactivation was successful, false otherwise

    • getAllTrainingAreas

      List<TrainingAreaDTO> getAllTrainingAreas()
      Retrieves all available training areas for categorization purposes. Provides the complete list of training subject categories.
      Returns:
      a list of TrainingAreaDTO objects representing all training areas

    • addTrainingArea

      TrainingAreaDTO addTrainingArea(TrainingAreaDTO trainingAreaDTO)
      Adds a new training area category to the system. Creates a new subject area for organizing training programs.
      Parameters:
      trainingAreaDTO - the training area data containing name and description
      Returns:
      a TrainingAreaDTO representing the created training area

    • getUnparticipatedTrainingsByUserId

      List<TrainingDTO> getUnparticipatedTrainingsByUserId(Long requesterId, Long userId)
      Retrieves training programs that a specific user has not yet participated in. Provides personalized training recommendations based on participation history.
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user making the request (for authorization)
      userId - the ID of the user to find unparticipated trainings for
      Returns:
      a list of TrainingDTO objects representing available training programs

    • getTrainingsByFilters

      List<TrainingDTO> getTrainingsByFilters(Long requesterId, TrainingFilter filters)
      Retrieves training programs based on specified filtering criteria. Supports complex filtering by area, status, date ranges, and other training attributes.
      Parameters:
      requesterId - the ID of the user making the request (used for authorization)
      filters - the filter criteria for training search
      Returns:
      a list of TrainingDTO objects matching the filter criteria
